positions.name: MissingIdSlugFallback
positions.frame: when a memory is submitted without an explicit id, what must the pipeline do to establish one?
positions.why: src-1 flatly asserts the submission's missing-id condition; src-2 states the pipeline's required response to exactly that condition — produce a slug via the LLM id-gen call or the deterministic slugify fallback, then commit the file. Read together, the condition and its mandated resolution form a single directional arc (absence → required remedy), not two independent facts. No tension: the assertive sets up what the directive resolves.
